task.question: What was the amount released by Shivraj Singh Chouhan for the VB-G RAM-G scheme in July 2026?
task.evidence: 5 July – Union Agriculture and Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan releases the first instalment of ₹25,863 crore (US$2.7 billion) to states for the implementation of the VB-G RAM-G scheme.

answer:
Great! I found the information. According to the search results from Mint (dated July 5, 2026), Rural development minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced that the Centre released **₹25,863 crore** for the VB-G RAM-G (Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar & Ajeevika Mahaabhiyaan - Gram Rozgar Abhiyaan) scheme in July 2026.

FINAL: ₹25,863 crore
